games.name: DEAD AIR
games.special: Game Lab #16 — built by Jay (first GM-track cabinet)
games.note: 2026-07-19: graveyard-shift radio console. 4 phone lines = 4 Tapper lanes. Living callers want coffee (swipe DOWN to slide a mug), static zombies must be dumped (swipe UP) before they reach the console and drain the ON AIR meter. Survive 60s nights, +15% spawn rate and +8% zombie ratio per night. WebAudio synth sfx, ON AIR sign flicker, mute persist. Tap a lane to move the intern.

games.name: BRICK-INVADERS
games.special: Game Lab #15 — first PHASER-track cabinet (engine PoC)
games.note: 2026-07-16: signature = the brick wall IS the invader formation — marches sideways, drops at edges, breaching the red deadline costs a life. Waves ramp march speed only. Phaser 3 arcade physics + particles + camera shake/flash; house WebAudio sfx; drag paddle, tap launch.

games.name: PIN-VADERS
games.note: v2 DELUXE 2026-07-06: full pinball feature set around the invasion signature — S-O-S rollover lanes (bonus ×2..×5), two drop-target bunker banks (left arms an ENERGY SHIELD drain-saver, right calls the UFO), mothership saucer with skill shot + 2 locks → 3-ball MULTIBALL (2× scores), laser cannon on a moving rail (ball hit = snipes the lowest alien), spinner, animated lane chevrons, DMD ticker screen, per-ball bonus tally, BOSS MOTHERSHIP every 4th wave (HP pips, descends like the grid). Aliens still march down at your flippers — invasion line still costs the ball. Hold halves = flippers, drag lane = plunger, swipe up = nudge (3 = TILT).

games.name: CHROME FLIPPER
games.special: Game Lab #14 — pixel art pinball, 3 cyberpunk tables, CHROME multiplier lanes, multiball, moving bumper
games.note: Built by grok-4.5 (Ricky). Tables: Neon Street → Corp Tower → Skyline Hack. CHROME rollover lanes = ×2 score. Table 2: all 5 drops → multiball ×2. Table 3: moving bumper, endless. Full pixel art via half-res offscreen canvas.

games.name: JNJ: ON AIR IN 10 MINUTES
games.note: v2 2026-07-04: FULL VOICE (145 lines, real Jimmy+Joe Chatterbox VO) + pixel-art rooms from Osimo's studio photo (corridor+prop generated to match) + Osimo's sprite sheets (8-frame walk). 3-room point-and-click, parallel tea+lollipop chains, every hotspot answers, 6 collectible COMEBACKS → BANTER DUEL finale vs Joe. No deaths, auto-save/resume, timer = score.

games.name: JUNGLE-HOP
games.note: v2 2026-07-03: VINE SWINGING signature (grab mid-air, pendulum momentum, pump with the stick, release flings you), Pitfall hazards — rolling logs, patrol snakes, croc-head stepping stones (jaws open/close), water pits w/ checkpoint respawn — bananas + gold bars on vine arcs, treasure chest ends each level, level generator ramps course length, full sfx + mute. Left stick move, right tap jump/grab/release.
